column1: # Dang, J., Honda, K. and Suzuki, H. (1994). Morphological and acoustical analysis of the nasal and the paranasal cavities.
# J. Acoust. Soc. Am. 96(4):2088-2100, doi:10.1121/1.410150; read from ATR technical report TR-H-0030 (1993-09-24), Fig. 6
# (pdf p.37, printed p.36): MRI cross-sectional area of the nasal passages of four adults (Sub.1 to Sub.4), cm^2, in 0.3 cm
# sections from the posterior end (section 0) to the nostrils; x_cm = 0.3 x section. passages 1 = one passage ('Whole');
# passages 2 = Left (under the lower line) and Right (the stippled band), as the figure's labels point; area_cm2 = left + right.
# Digitized by pixel from the figure; the ledger row dang-honda-suzuki-1994-nasal-areas gives the method, the measured error
# and two findings in the source. flag '-': the two neighbouring gaps agree within 2.5 px (0.037 cm^2); otherwise the curve,
# both gap values (cm^2) and the gap kept; 'left:unreadable' = the figure's arrowhead covers both gaps, left blank.
